outlook.statement: Entered new fiscal year with optimism and sharpened focus on innovation-led growth; aim to strengthen presence in high-potential therapeutic areas, deepen hospital reach, fast-track high-value product launches, emphasize cost rationalization, optimize field force productivity, enhance working capital management, and make selective investments in high-margin brands

The Company has continued its strategic focus on increasing the Hospital Business contribution within the overall revenue mix, in line with its long-term aspiration of leadership in the Indian Hospital Business.

Union Budget 2026-27 has provided positive direction to the sector through the launch of the Biopharma SHAKTI initiative (Rs. 10,000 Crore over five years) and Basic Customs Duty (BCD) exemption on 17 lifesaving drugs and medicines.
Medium-term aspirations of revenue growth at a CAGR of 35% over the next three years and maintaining EBITDA margins above 25%, supported by Hospital Business strategy and new product pipeline
Indian pharmaceutical sector revenue growth of 7–9% in FY26, domestic market expanding 8–10%
Global pharmaceutical market projected to grow at 5–8% CAGR through 2030, reaching approximately US$ 2.6 trillion
Indian hospital industry positioned to grow at 11–12% CAGR over next 3–5 years

The Company continues to actively promote responsible business practices across its value chain and has laid out structured initiatives for the upcoming period to enhance awareness of the Business Responsibility and Sustainability Principles.
The Company is working towards establishing mechanisms to measure and report the sustainability of its sourcing practices and intends to disclose this information in the coming years.
Life Cycle Perspective / Assessments (LCA) for any of its products or services shall be assessed in the upcoming years and taken up accordingly.
